Ugmuls 5.5e Automation · v0.8.3

More magic.
Room to react.

Warlock, Artificer and Druid features join the connected combat workflow. Prepare elixirs, transform, choose a constellation and resolve supported companion actions through native rolls and chat cards.

New optional reactive automation gives Shield, Weal/Woe and other usable adjustments their place before damage and effects are applied. Keep manual Apply and Undo when the table needs them.

Explore the class guide →

0.8.3

Reactive damage and effects

  • Let players react before the damage lands. Turn on the optional reactive setting and a usable Shield, Weal/Woe, Flash of Genius or supported adjustment stops automatic application for that card. There is no timer pressuring the player to choose.
  • Use the reaction and the card updates its result, then checks whether anything else can be used. If nobody is reacting, the GM can simply Apply damage. Hit effects follow the damage and save effects follow the save outcomes.
  • Corrections stay usable: a Shield miss prevents damage, a miss changed to a hit opens the right damage roll instead of Graze, and applied results keep their Undo controls.
0.8.3

Warlock

  • Spend less time keeping pact and patron benefits in sync. Add supported bonus damage while rolling a hit, use available reactions from the relevant card, and let the module track resources and effect durations.
  • Fey Step guides its follow-up targets, Celestial rest choices hand out temporary HP, and Fiend resistance can be chosen as part of a rest. Undead fear and linked Dread benefits follow the form.
  • Semblance of Life transforms the existing Vestige into its scaled spirit form and restores it afterward. No extra actor or manually rebuilt token is needed.
0.8.3

Artificer

  • Prepare a Spell-Storing Item for yourself or a friendly character. Select a recipient, one of their eligible items and a spell; its holder can then cast straight from that item, with charges, rolls and concentration handled through the usual spell controls.
  • Brew Experimental Elixirs in one rolled table and send each bottle directly to its recipient. Add Alchemical Savant while rolling and use Alchemical Eruption after qualifying damage.
  • A Steel Defender can Deflect from the incoming attack card, updating a hit to a miss when appropriate. Reanimator players choose summon modifications and can resolve Life Transfer with its healing, centered Death Burst and transfer summary.
0.8.3

Druid

  • Choose a beast and transform immediately. Eligible Beast Spells stay accessible on the transformed sheet, and concentration begun in beast form stays connected when you revert.
  • Moon attacks offer Radiant choices and bonus damage. Land choices and slot recovery fit into rests. Sea bearers receive turn-start Wrath actions, with shared initial targeting when the gift is given to two creatures.
  • Stars players choose a constellation on activation, fire Archer from chat and direct Healing Chalice to the creature they want to heal. Cosmic Omen rolls after rest and offers Weal/Woe when a nearby result is eligible.
0.8.3

Spells and shared workflow

  • Conjure Animals follows the moving pack with its area and gathers eligible enemies onto the turn’s existing save and damage cards. Passed saves deal no damage.
  • Once Conjure Elemental restrains a creature, its repeat saves and damage follow the creature’s turns until it gets free. Acid Arrow’s lingering damage also offers its follow-up roll.
  • Guiding Bolt and Faerie Fire supply their supported attack Advantage, while linked companions that act on their owner’s turn can recover abilities and expire effects without a separate initiative entry.
0.8.3

Updating and compatibility

  • Refresh GM and player clients after installation. Keep an active GM connected for managed operations; use fresh casts/effects when checking changed workflows.
  • Foundry VTT 14; D&D5e 6.0.5 minimum, verified configuration 6.0.6. Required modules remain Automated Conditions 5e and Dice So Nice. This release adds no required animation module.
  • Features use matching official source activities/effects; book content is not bundled. Imported/homebrew versions may need adjustments. Existing local automation-library overrides remain in control.
  • Use Grid Shaped emanations and scene grid distances that match the map. Choice-heavy mechanics and deferred features remain manual; Reanimator Life Jolt and other unimplemented modification procs are not included.
